explanations.12: The split('/') breaks the path into parts, filter(Boolean) removes empty strings (like from double slashes), and pop() grabs the last part — so '/docs/react/' becomes 'react'.
explanations.13: This replaces sequences of hyphens or underscores with spaces, converting 'docker-cs_fixer' into 'docker cs fixer' so it's more readable for a search query.
explanations.29: The arrow function passed to useState ensures the random message is chosen only once when the component mounts, not on every render.
explanations.37: This effect automatically opens the search palette with the guessed search term whenever the query changes, giving users a quick way to search without typing.
